CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue coordinates) and organization/presentation (grid orientation and node listings) are given alongside explicit origin/status metadata for the same node/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (colour-labelled coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from explicit origin/status metadata for the same node/time, distinguishing content from its status/organization.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are organized/presented (grid orientation, node coordinate sets, and candidate/origin structure).
